conf.description: apache-httpd error dataset, syslog-raw format (ErrorLogFormat text, 2.4 module:loglevel/pid:tid form and legacy 2.2 form): parsing is deferred entirely to the Elastic apache integration's error grok, which also pulls file.path and http.request.referrer out of "File does not exist" messages. This pipeline is intentionally thin: it only tags event.dataset and passes _raw through untouched.

conf.comment: apache-httpd / error / syslog-raw: ErrorLogFormat lines shipped as plain text (Elastic Agent file tail, or raw syslog where ErrorLog is a syslog facility). Do NOT re-grok [%{u}t] [%m:%l] [pid %P:tid %T] %M / AHnnnnn here -- the Elastic apache integration's error pipeline groks both the 2.4 module:loglevel/pid:tid form and the older 2.2 form, and adds a second pass extracting file.path/http.request.referrer from "File does not exist" messages. Re-implementing that grok in Cribl would fight the integration and produce duplicate or conflicting fields.
